facts.fact: Severn builds single-family houses with its own crew for framing, drywall, finish carpentry and site labor, and uses subcontractors for some trades; eight employees
The owner, Martin Severn, has filed an election of exclusion and is not on the payroll register

Three houses were under construction; the office manager drives material and paperwork out to the sites and meets inspectors; the estimator visits a site now and then; the bookkeeper stays in the office
Three subcontractors were paid in the period (framing, drywall, roofing); the certificates collected are the ones the owner could find

The file holds certificates for Tenbury Ridge Framing Co. (MD-WC-448201, 2025-06-01 to 2026-12-31) and Kent Island Roofing & Siding LLC (MD-WC-517736, 2025-04-01 to 2026-01-31); none for Tidewater Drywall
